name: Darkan
storyline: Long ago, the kings of Darkan sealed ancient forces beneath the land. Now the Seal is cracking. In Guardaventos, priests and archivists ask adventurers to uncover the nine discoveries of the Cracked Seal. The truth they find is a warning: the Seal is not a weapon, it is a prison. The trail leads to Moran Castle, above the Shadow Crypt of Eternal Fall. There, Odrakhan's blood keeps something asleep, and at the bottom waits Aurelion, the last dhampir lord. This begins the Age of Blood.
summary: Darkan is a free-to-play 2D online RPG (MMORPG) with a classic top-down look, playable on PC, Android and in the browser. Choose a Knight, Paladin or Mage, level up with your own passive skill tree, and explore a dark fantasy world: cities, hunting grounds, crypts and castles. Hunt monsters alone or in a party, take on daily tasks and the Prey system, and face the bosses Anubis, Odrakhan and Aurelion. Their sets drop in +1, +2 and +3 versions with random bonus lines. There is PvP, trading with other players, a daily reward and regular updates.
